text: Authenticate server-side requests with a scoped key and never expose it to browser code.
Configure a bounded request deadline and record timeout causes separately from server errors.
A batch result preserves the input identifier and reports a terminal status for every item.
Structured responses are validated against the selected JSON schema before publication.
Execute approved tool calls, append their results, and continue with the same conversation state.
Record request identifiers, latency, model version, and retry count in operational telemetry.
